ModMetaData.name: RIMWORLD-STARGATE: Parallel Gates
ModMetaData.author: panzmoravylab, based on RimGate Jaffa/Kree by Helixien, Xen, Mlie and contributors
ModMetaData.description:
RIMWORLD-STARGATE: Parallel Gates is a RimWorld 1.6 Stargate-inspired prototype built from the RimGate Jaffa/Kree mod base.
Current MVP features: - Jaffa race, factions, armor, helmets, weapons, sounds, and names updated for RimWorld 1.6. - Czech localization for current custom content. - Spawnable StarGate building and StarGate control panel. - StarGate warmup, animated online/offline visual state, and panel-driven activation. - Pawn and group travel from a home gate to a generated remote StarGate map and back. - Manual three-ring StarGate address dialing UI with saved address records. - Persistent 150x150 off-world planet maps that preserve player changes across save/load. - Deterministic planet biomes, ruins, settlements, outposts, and active-faction inhabitants. - Scannable secondary planet sites with their own persistent maps. - Harmony foundation for future multi-world/planet travel mechanics.
Requirements: - Harmony - Humanoid Alien Races - Odyssey (required for a full independent RimWorld globe per Stargate address)
Credits: Based on RimGate Jaffa/Kree by Helixien, Xen, Mlie and contributors, with original texture credits to Carnov and Humanoid Alien Races work by CPT.OHU/Erdelf and contributors.
This is an unofficial fan mod and is not affiliated with or endorsed by MGM, Amazon, Ludeon Studios, or the original mod authors.
